long_biography.plain_text:
Pure Genetic Lifestyle, the testing business founded by Maarten van Dijk, worked with designers to make laboratory results understandable to consumers. Visualisations, animations and explanatory text accompanied a printed summary, while a personal online account held more detailed information and genetic tables.

As chief executive of Pure Medical, van Dijk has also worked on bringing genetic tests into healthcare systems. A research and distribution agreement with Singlera Genomics provided for collaboration with universities and hospital networks across western Europe. The partnership focused on cancer detection, with work planned towards commercial introduction of colorectal and pancreatic cancer tests.
